title: {enemy:raider}
text:
前面有个{enemy:raider}，一把小刀，不难对付。

信力是这样涨的：{faith:brute}看你打出去和挨到的伤害，每点算 {faith_deed:brute:damage:multiplier} 信力，一场最多 {faith_deed:brute:damage:cap}；还有失去体力，每点算 {faith_deed:brute:vitality_lost:multiplier} —— 输了也不白输。

打完把鼠标停到顶端栏的徽记上看看。

texts.en:
A {enemy:raider} up ahead. One small knife. Not much trouble.

Here's how Faith grows. {faith:brute} watches the damage you deal and the damage you take: {faith_deed:brute:damage:multiplier} Faith per point, up to {faith_deed:brute:damage:cap} a battle. Lost Vitality counts too, {faith_deed:brute:vitality_lost:multiplier} per point. Even a loss isn't wasted.

After the fight, hover over the emblem in the top bar and have a look.

options.label: 进入战前准备
options.hint_when_hidden: 先把{item:charm_brute}放进包里（按 {key:B} 打开背包；留在上一个点的话，回去拿），信了{faith:brute}再打。

hints_when_hidden.en: Put the {item:charm_brute} in your bag first (press {key:B} to open your pack; if you left it at the last spot, go back for it). Follow {faith:brute}, then fight.
